zh.title: 聯邦快遞波音777F直飛成都至亞特蘭大運送兩隻大熊貓
zh.summary: 聯邦快遞777F直飛成都至亞特蘭大運送兩熊貓；飛行15小時
body: 據Simple Flying報導，聯邦快遞調派一架波音777F貨機執行「熊貓快運」任務，從中國成都直飛美國亞特蘭大，機上載運兩隻大熊貓，飛行約15小時，航程近6,900海里，全程不經停。
報導指出，該航班飛行時間約15小時，航程近6,900海里，全程不經停直達。
Simple Flying報導標題為「2 Giant Pandas Fly 15 Hours Nonstop From China To Atlanta On FedEx Boeing 777F」，摘要指出「The FedEx 'Panda Express' flew nearly 6,900 nautical miles nonstop from Chengdu to Atlanta」 。

en.title: FedEx Boeing 777F flies two giant pandas nonstop from Chengdu to Atlanta
en.summary: FedEx 777F flies two pandas nonstop Chengdu to Atlanta; 15-hour flight
body: According to a report published by the aviation news website Simple Flying on September 27, 2026, FedEx Express operated a Boeing 777F freighter aircraft on a dedicated "Panda Express" flight, departing from Chengdu in China and arriving nonstop at Atlanta in the United States, transporting two giant pandas.
The summary accompanying the report states that the flight covered a distance of nearly 6,900 nautical miles and had a flight time of approximately 15 hours, with no intermediate stops en route.

The headline of the article is "2 Giant Pandas Fly 15 Hours Nonstop From China To Atlanta On FedEx Boeing 777F" and the summary reads "The FedEx 'Panda Express' flew nearly 6,900 nautical miles nonstop from Chengdu to Atlanta".
